Coram : UJJAL BHUYAN, J.B. PARDIWALA*
Issue for Consideration Matter pertains to correctness of the order imposing penalty on the carrier u/s.38(3) of the Finance Act, 1979 for delayed payment of Foreign Travel Tax-FTT into the Government treasury; and as to whether a litigant can be worse off by approaching the appellate forum as or by approaching a court of law. Headnotes† Finance Act, 1979 – s.38(3), (4) – Foreign Travel Tax Rules, 1979 – Imposition of penalty – Delay in deposit of Foreign Travel Tax-FTT by the carrier – Appellant-Airlines, collected FTT from passengers going abroad
Decision Date : 01-09-2026 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 1052/2013 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
